prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Before Waiting Generation Stage: Reorders the sign-in step so authentication occurs after adoption certificate creation, right before the long asset waiting stage.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Docking Preview Flow: Adds an interactive docking preview sub-flow right after waiting stage where users test dragging and anchoring the companion to screen corners.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_docking_preview", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true}}
2: [finish, redesign] Split Card Layout for Final Desktop Pet Launch: Redesigns the final home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing companion desktop controls alongside a prominent launch call to action.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Your pet is active and ready to live on your workspace screen.", "button_label": "Release Pet to Desktop"}}
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Activity Preference Screen: Inserts a dedicated activity preference screen after path selection where users select primary companion behaviors like work focus or idle relaxation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_activity_pref", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Sync Guarantee Notice: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure returning users that logging in syncs and restores existing desktop pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore & Protect Your Pets", "body": "Log in to immediately sync existing desktop companions, custom traits, and saved items to this device."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Background Asset Extraction & Safety Progress Indicator: Displays breakdown progress details and estimated setup time on the waiting screen while companion assets render.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Finalizing Companion Desktop Assets", "body": "Configuring desktop animations and spatial physics. Your pet will appear on screen momentarily.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true}}
6: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Sound & Expression Preview Flow: Adds an interactive sound and expression preview stage into the adoption journey before completing certificate generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_sound_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [adoption, incentive] First Day Desktop Toy Bonus Unlock: Adds a highlighted bonus badge to the adoption certificate screen awarding an exclusive initial desktop toy perk upon completing setup.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Bonus Desktop Toy Unlocked", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Render Completion Desktop Notification: Enables desktop readiness notifications and helpful hint copy allowing users to safely minimize the application during long renders.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You can safely minimize this window while your pet builds. We'll send a notification when ready!"}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Control & Visibility Quick Tip Copy: Adds concise guidance copy on the home_intro screen explaining how to access system tray controls and toggle desktop pet visibility.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Quick tip: Right-click your pet on desktop or use the System Tray icon anytime to access controls or toggle visibility."}}
